limitations: These are six disposable Linux6.8 x86_64 QEMU model runs. Real hardwareG1/G2, other kernels/devices, ISO, generic crossconfiguration/recovery and entirePhase3 completion remain separate.

All two pool devices are granted to the single client principal in these QEMU configs. Authorized catalog visibility, busy hiding and localUID denials are observed; an otherwise valid but ungranted network certificate guessing a key is not a newQEMU negative here.

No TLS decryption/keylog. Capture proves ClientHello ALPN/SNI offers, ServerHelloTLS1.3 selection, complete encrypted-record framing and absence of specified signatures. Negotiated ALPN/clientcert verification additionally depend on fixed auditedTLS source and successful actual protocol/I/O; not packet-only visibility.

Public DER signatures/CA/EKU/name and recordedguest time checked offline; no secret/privatekey bytes read or archived. Actual trusted-file modes are enforced at startup by audited loader; do not invent independentstat fields absent from raw.

ProcUID/caps/ELF SHA and kernel/sysfs facts are original guest observations correlated across raw files and exact frozen source, not live re-observation after guests stopped or a downloadedELF rehash.

TLSstream purposes cannot be decrypted from PCAP; association with DEVLIST/IMPORT/URB follows actual CLI source, catalog/receipts and real I/O plus no other application transport on complete external captures.
Recognizable specified management/URB/35B fixture signature absence is a finite leak check, not a universal no-information-leak theorem.
Both-family3240 SYN/RST probes establish refusal on those tested endpoints/ports, not a scan of every port or exclusion of a trusted root administrator starting another service.
Earlier first/second/third failures and f955 capture-parserFAIL remain unchanged, independently attributed. This report covers only six terminal b83c931 runs.
Current documentationdirty worktree after run is distinct from recordedcleanrun guards; immutableGit blobs and archived bytes anchor the runningcandidate.
